utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10 this Saturday, and just bring any tools or spare parts you can donate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a few spare tools. Do you need people to stay and help during the drive, too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — I might need a wrench and maybe a screwdriver, if I can find the list again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ve got a wrench and a screwdriver you can borrow. Just send me the list when you find it, and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Pia — I heard the repair drive is getting some real momentum. If you want, I can pass along the latest details as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. I’m a little worried about the timing and where everything’s getting dropped off, so please keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the timing or drop-off spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you pick up the repair supplies from the hardware store on Maple and bring them by my place? I’ve got the list ready if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — send me the list and I’ll swing by the hardware store on Maple and bring the supplies over after.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and see who wants to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll start letting folks know right away and circle back if anyone’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let me know what you want me to prioritize first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Please start with the urgent fixes first, then send me the list so I can help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You got it, Leo — I’ll start with the urgent fixes and send you the list as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help—what details do we need to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — I’ll join late, so can you confirm the time, place, and what tools or supplies we should bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the time and place first, then I’ll check what tools or supplies are needed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara — I’m happy to help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking after school, around 3:30 to 5:30, so folks can swing by with the kids out of class.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help cover that window and make sure it fits around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — I’m a bit behind on the details. What’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard it’s meant to help folks fix small household items together—tools, parts, and a bit of guidance on hand. I can check the exact time and bring you the details if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still catching up, so the time and place would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm you’re still in for the repair drive, and tell me what time you can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still in. I can help around 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll stop by and see what still needs fixing. If you’ve got a list, I can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rey. I keep meaning to write it down — the porch light, the loose gate, and maybe that leaky faucet if I can find the wrench.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the porch light and gate first, and I’ll bring a wrench in case the faucet’s doable too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be wonderful, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies, and you can help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan to the neighbors so everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest myself yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I’d appreciate that. I’ll check back with you later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great—thanks, Oren. I’ll point you toward the repair table, and we can get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—I’m heading to the repair table now. Just let me know what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand and bring over some tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that. If you can bring a wrench set and a flashlight, I’ll make a clear list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a wrench set and a flashlight for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Mara — could you help me spread the word and bring anyone who wants to lend a hand? I’ll share the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see who’s interested in helping out. Send me the details, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be glad to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word or help organize anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great—could you spread the word and let me know if anyone can help with sorting donations?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and ask around for folks who can help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Cleo—want to go over the priority fixes first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, let’s start with the priority fixes—I’ve got a few supplies set aside already.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you—let’s start with the biggest safety issues first and then we can match your supplies to the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—have you seen where they’re collecting things?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I think they’re collecting at the community center entrance. Do you want me to check the exact drop-off times?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I’m not sure I’d catch the right time otherwise. If you find it, let me know and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just tell me where to drop off the repair stuff and when.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — you can drop it off at my place after school, around 3:30. If that doesn’t work, I can swing by and grab it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—after school at 3:30 works for me. I’ll drop it by your place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ve got the right repair drive before we start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’ve got the repair drive ready. What’s the best way to confirm it’s the right one?
